page.overview:
Who is Darth VaGhal?

Darth VaGhal was a Human female Sith Lord VaGhal had yellow eyes; black, braided hair; light skin; and black markings on their face and forehead.

VaGhal wore a black outfit that was comprised of both cloth and armor. Portions of VaGhal's torso and arms were exposed while the armor primarily covered their neck. Thin tendrils extended out of the outfit near VaGhal's elbows. In addition to the upper body armor, VaGhal wore a long black skirt made up of the same material as the tendrils extending from their forearms. VaGhal also wielded a purple-bladed lightsaber with a black hilt.

Darth VaGhal is a character created for Red Fly Studio's canceled video game Battle of the Sith Lords. VaGhal's design was created by concept artist Thomas A. Szakolczay
